hypothesis: Separate trend strength, pullback depth, closing pressure, and cost/risk width from no_dow; six bounded candidates
baseline: no_dow common reference, original baseline and buyhold; reference never promoted to selectable candidate

entry_rules.warmup: 2016-07-12 onwards; A requires 26 bars, B/ATR require positive valid ATR, base requires 24 bars

exit_rules.rules: Baseline simulate unchanged: next open above stop, prior3 low SL, symmetric TP, gap opens, both-hit SL first, entry-day exits, one position, final close liquidation

final_period_prior_exposure: All periods previously viewed, retrospective research; not independent untouched holdout
risk_band_origin: Exploratory hypothesis based on already-viewed 2017-2019 no_dow actual-entry risk subset diagnostic; new filter uses signal-close risk, not entry risk
cost_and_fill_model: Old simulate unchanged; one-way main0.001/stress0.002; DATA_LIMITED Yahoo backward-adjusted OHLC; Sony adjustment and two envelope repairs; no dividends/taxes/interest
position_sizing_and_currency: Each independent sleeve 100000 JPY all cash including costs, 10 sleeves, fractional adjusted shares; no leverage/rebalance
selection_rule: Training-qualified only validation, validation-qualified max main PF then fewer added conditions then lexical ID; save maximum one before final; none stops candidate path
cross_symbol_rule: Final positive net in >=6/10; 9/7 subsets diagnostics only
reference_tracking: After selection save, always track fixed no_dow/baseline/buyhold validation/final/continuous, never eligible for adoption
code_identifier: scripts/research_tamukai_stocks_deep.py and reused daily/jev/indicators; SHA256 before execution
